protocol_name: Independent Recruiter Annotation Reliability & Quality Assurance Specification

independence_architecture.workflow_type: Double-Blind Independent Annotation with Tie-Break Adjudication
blinded_factors: Peer annotator ratings (Annotators work in isolated queues)
Candidate PII / Identity (Demographic and direct identifying attributes stripped)
Job Company PII (Firm names masked to prevent prestige bias)
independence_architecture.cardinal_rule: Inter-annotator agreement metrics (Kappa, percent concordance) MUST be computed strictly on pre-adjudication ratings. Computing reliability on adjudicated consensus labels is strictly prohibited.

unweighted_cohen_kappa.purpose: Measures exact category concordance corrected for chance agreement

quadratic_weighted_cohen_kappa.formula: kappa_w = 1 - (sum(w_ij * O_ij) / sum(w_ij * E_ij)) where w_ij = ((i - j) / (k - 1))^2
quadratic_weighted_cohen_kappa.purpose: Primary statistical reliability metric penalizing ordinal discordance (Class 0 vs Class 2 discordance penalized 4x higher than Class 0 vs Class 1)

per_class_concordance.metric: Class-specific F1 and recall between raters

adjudication_rate.definition: Proportion of pairs where Rater 1 != Rater 2 requiring Senior Lead Adjudication

trigger_conditions.action: Immediate batch halt; freeze annotation queue; mandatory rubric calibration workshop.
Mandatory audit of annotator pairs; check for systematic misunderstandings of mandatory vs preferred criteria.
Annotator disqualified; past annotations flagged for complete re-rating by alternative qualified recruiter.

corrective_workflow: Step 1: Isolate discordance sub-matrix to determine whether ambiguity stems from seniority, tech stack equivalence, or domain boundaries.
Step 2: Update Annotation Rubric with targeted edge-case clarifications and concrete exemplars.
Step 3: Conduct a 30-pair consensus calibration exercise.
Step 4: Discard discordant batch from final benchmark queue; re-annotate fresh sampled pairs.

adjudication_governance.adjudicator_profile: Lead Technical Recruiter or Principal Hiring Manager with >= 7 years domain experience
adjudication_rules: Adjudicator has access to both Rater 1 and Rater 2 evidence quotes and rationales.
Adjudicator makes independent final classification from {0, 1, 2}.
Adjudicated labels form the definitive evaluation benchmark ground truth.
Adjudicated labels are NEVER fed into model training, fine-tuning, or hyperparameter optimization (quarantine enforced).
